description: Defines the NewtonsoftJsonCodecOptions class which provides configuration options for the NewtonsoftJsonCodec in Orleans serialization. Includes properties for serializer settings and delegate functions for type support checks.

classes.name: NewtonsoftJsonCodecOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the NewtonsoftJsonCodec, including serializer settings and support type delegates.

methods.name: SerializerSettings
methods.description: Getter and setter for the JsonSerializerSettings used by the codec.

methods.name: IsSerializableType
methods.description: Delegate to determine if a type is serializable.

methods.name: IsCopyableType
methods.description: Delegate to determine if a type is copyable.
